summary: Prove an arbitrary-length in-place array loop and reusable deterministic termination rules.

examined.reason: New contract was written before implementation. Reviewed the exact word/byte distinction, immediate mask and fallback, initial-state boundary, strict count/one-past bounds, ten-step iteration, zero-length exit, all-completed-run output and frame, prefix bound and infinite-execution exclusion. Definitions and completed Lean proofs implement these conditions without final-result premises.

Added proof rules over unchanged dispatch and run relations. Prefix completion requires the explicit Functional catalog premise, instantiated by ReviewedPure.functional; the halting witness supplies the finite bound. General nondeterministic choices remain unchanged.
Only new dependency audit entries were appended; message-passing statements, semantics and evidence are unchanged.

The array example is another small kernel instantiating the existing example responsibility: explicit computation, reproducible checks, concrete execution conditions and separate fidelity claims. No network-example contract changed.

The loop uses the existing word memory and instruction transitions without altering their semantics, target policy or unsupported boundaries; reusable rules prove new consequences of those unchanged relations.

results.method: bash scripts/check.sh; lake env lean examples/array_mask_select.lean; stratic validate; git diff --check; manual contract and proof review
results.environment: Linux; pinned Lean 4.34.0; Python 3.11+; existing local source cache; no external inference calls.
results.evidence: Exact pre/post snapshot trees match. Core check passed: 1507 distinct dependency reports with only standard Lean logical axioms; 22 selected accepted forms and 1050 archived files across 13 archives verified. Concrete array example passed: multi-element output with surrounding words, empty and symbolic singleton executions, counter/address overflow exclusions and adjacent accepted address bound; printed [52, 99, 99, 255] and []. Stratic valid, no issues; whitespace check clean. Manual review checked program/trace correspondence, nonwrapping initialization, exact iteration state equality, list-induction witness, determinism-derived all-run result and finite-prefix/infinite-execution exclusion. No result, existence or termination hypotheses hide missing semantics. TorchLean integration also passed this block with 363 exact dependency reports before the final comment and description-only edits; its code and proof terms are unchanged.
